caseName: Pacific Coast Steel Co. v. McLaughlin
caseNameFull: Pacific Coast Steel Co. v. McLaughlin, Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Ralph W. Smith and George H. Koster for petitioner. Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Youngquist, and Messrs. Whitney North Seymour, Sewall Key, J. P. Jackson, and Wm. H: Riley, Jr., for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit granted, limited to the question of the effect of § 278 (e) of the Revenue Act of 1924.
